name: archify
description: Create validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle/state, entity-relationship, class/interface, tree, timeline, and execution waterfall diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional motion, and image/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or Mermaid; inspect repository evidence for code-backed diagrams. Use when visualizing infrastructure, cloud/security networks, API calls, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, state machines, database
